description:
FILED s523a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-20) from #3282's measurement.  SILENT WRONG, pre-existing (base 8038fac6 identical).  PARKED-AREA: cl/pack-impl.pl is the pack oracle the USER parked (DECIDED: "pack/unpack PARKED (USER) until the XS decision"; the board review's "NOT IN THE PLAN" table lists "the pack park" as a USER decision) -- so s523a did NOT fix it; lifting it for this one rule is a Fable/USER call.

perl's rule (perlfunc pack, probed 5.40.3): a template that BEGINS with `U` is in U0 (character) mode.  pack's result is a CHARACTER string; unpack reads the string's characters.  A `U` later in the template (or after `C0`) packs / reads UTF-8 BYTES.  PCL applies the bytes rule always:
  pack('U', 0x83)          perl 1 char (131)        PCL 2 chars 194,131
  pack('U*', 0x1F600)      perl 1 char              PCL 4 chars 240,159,152,128
  unpack('U*', "\x01\x41\x83\xe9\xff")   perl 1,65,131,233,255   PCL 1,65,233,7
  unpack('U*', "\xc3\xa9") perl 195,169             PCL 233
  unpack('U*', chr(300))   perl 300                 PCL garbage (4)
  (`unpack('a U*', "x\xc3\xa9")` = x,233 and `unpack('U0U*', ...)` already agree with perl.)
Probes: scratch/s523a/pr/j2.pl, j3.pl, j5.pl in the s523a worktree.

THE SHAPE OF THE FIX (one rule, two copies -- p_pack and p_unpack in cl/pack-impl.pl, then tools/rebuild-pack): p_unpack's `my $utf8_mode = ($tmpl =~ s/^U0//)` should also be true for a template whose first item is `U` (not `U0` stripped -- the U stays as the first item and decodes the re-encoded bytes); p_pack should utf8::decode its byte result when the template begins with `U` (perl's "the resulting string is treated as UTF-8").  Probe pack.t's U rows before / after; the 47 parked pack.t keys may move.

COST OF NOT FIXING: JSON::PP's ascii / latin1 encoders (`unpack('U*', $_[0])`) and its \u decoder (`pack('U', hex)` + utf8::encode / utf8::decode) both go through it -- every JSON::PP ascii/latin1 encode of a non-ASCII char is wrong, and decoding any `\uXXXX` above 0x7F yields UTF-8 bytes.  That is the whole of JSON-PP t/099_binaryNN.t (16 files, 24,512 perl rows, #3282) and probably more of the JSON-PP board rows.  A one-iteration probe with JSON::PP::_encode_ascii replaced by a `map ord, split //` version (scratch/s523a/pr/c3patch.pl) stops the die; the decode half still fails the 4 ascii round trips.


=== USER DECISION (2026-10-21) ===
#3650 DECIDED (USER, 2026-10-21 02:4x, between s523 and s524): the pack park is LIFTED for the ONE U0 rule, on two conditions -- the change is SMALL and it costs NO execution speed; QUEUED for s524.  The rule: a template that BEGINS with `U` is in U0 character mode (pack returns a character string; unpack reads characters); one rule, two copies in cl/pack-impl.pl (p_pack / p_unpack), then tools/rebuild-pack + gen bump + the three artifacts.  THE BAR = the conditions: (1) the diff is the two-copy rule and nothing else (the park holds for every other pack line); (2) bench rows `pack` + `packunpk` base vs tree within the noise band (the mode test is one template-prefix check per call; a MEASURED cost returns the member to the USER unmerged); acceptance per the s523c member text: JSON-PP 099_binary03.t 0 -> 1,536 rows, the sixteen 099 files' blessed rows out by edit, perl-tests/pack.t's U rows hold or rise, the 47 parked pack.t keys re-blessed ROW BY ROW with causes.  Assignment at resume by readiness (the member text is in s523/s523c-prompt.md; do NOT delay s523c's merge -- the install-matrix fix rides in it).

=== DONE (s531a, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-01) ===
The USER-lifted ONE rule, ported unchanged from s523c's checkpoint ff7a05d9 onto main (cl/pack-impl.pl only had not moved since): p_pack utf8::decodes its result when the template's first non-white-space character is U (a one-character compare first), p_unpack's $lead_u joins the U0 mode; tools/rebuild-pack.  THE USER'S TWO CONDITIONS: (1) the diff is the two-copy rule (11 lines in cl/pack-impl.pl) + the rebuilt artifact; (2) bench (scratch/s531a/bench3650.log, tools/bench-exec.pl with BENCH_RT_B = the ade297e7 base runtime, interleaved, best-of-9, two passes, load ~1.9): pack B/A -0.1 % / -0.5 %, packunpk -0.3 % / +1.0 % = no cost.  Guard Pl/t/pack-u0-01.t (2 rows, perl as oracle, both FAIL on ade297e7).  Acceptance: JSON-PP 099_binary 16 x 1536/1536 (#3282) + 001_utf8 9/0, 014_latin1 4/0, 020_faihu 3/0, 108_decode 7/0, 109_encode 7/0, 112_upgrade 3/0, 119_incr_parse_utf8 rows 3-4 -- 42 board rows out by edit.  perl-tests/pack.t: see the full sweep in the s531a report.  Branch head: b969a960.
